description: This Java class 'LocationTagEditor' functions as a property editor for LocationTag objects in the OpenMRS core system. It provides methods to retrieve LocationTag instances by ID and UUID, facilitating property binding and data conversion within the application.

classes.name: LocationTagEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for LocationTag objects, enabling conversion from string inputs (IDs and UUIDs) to LocationTag instances.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag object by its integer ID using the OpenMRS Context's LocationService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationTag object by its UUID string using the OpenMRS Context's LocationService.
